items.title: Bajaj Finserv Q1 net up 18% on NBFC strength
items.description: Bajaj Finserv announced an eighteen percent profit increase for the June quarter. This growth was primarily fueled by strong consumer finance earnings. Bajaj Finance saw its profit after tax rise by twenty-eight percent. However, profits at general and life insurance units experienced declines. Bajaj Housing Finance reported a twenty-three percent profit increase.

items.title: ITC Q1 profit plunges 27% due to record cigarette taxes and West Asia crisis
items.description: ITC's first quarter net profit declined twenty-seven percent year-on-year. Record taxation on cigarettes significantly impacted the company's core business operations. The West Asia crisis also negatively affected agri-business exports during the period. However, the FMCG segment showed resilience with revenue and profit growth. Consumption remained steady across rural and urban markets despite inflation concerns.

items.title: Maruti Suzuki Q1 profit drops 11% to Rs 3,352 crore amid rising input costs
items.description: Maruti Suzuki reported an eleven percent profit decline in the June quarter. Rising input costs, aggravated by West Asia hostilities, impacted profitability significantly.  However, net sales climbed thirty-six percent to ₹49,959 crore during the same period. Unit sales also saw a strong twenty-nine percent increase, reaching a record 682,724 cars. The company also approved four compressed bio gas projects with a budget of ₹561 crore.

items.title: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions posts Rs 55-cr profit in Q1
items.description: CleanMax Enviro Energy Solutions achieved a net profit of Rs 55 crore in the June quarter.  This profit resulted from a substantial 107 percent year-on-year revenue increase.  The company's operational asset base and RE Services segment saw significant growth.  CleanMax also plans to raise Rs 2,500 crore through debenture issuance.  A record 500 MW capacity was added in the first quarter.

items.title: Divi's Labs Q1 Results: Net profit rises 66% YoY to Rs 902 crore, revenue up 28%
items.description: The firm’s revenue from operations meanwhile rose around 28% YoY to Rs 3,080 crore in Q1 FY27, from Rs 2,410 crore reported in the year-ago period. Its total income increased over 24% YoY to Rs 3,144 crore, while total expenses rose more than 9% YoY to Rs 1,964 crore during the quarter which ended on June 30, 2026.

items.title: GHCL Q1 profit rises 32% to Rs 191 cr on lower costs, warns of margin pressure ahead
items.description: GHCL reported a thirty-two percent profit increase for the first quarter. Lower expenses helped boost net profit to Rs 191.18 crore from Rs 144.78 crore. Total income fell three point zero six percent while total expenses declined. New projects are nearing commercial operations in the second quarter of FY27. Long-term soda ash industry fundamentals remain positive for GHCL.

items.title: CDSL Q1 Results: Net profit rises 15% YoY to Rs 118 crore, revenue up 13%
items.description: The Indian central securities depository’s revenue from operations meanwhile increased more than 13% YoY to Rs 293 crore during the quarter under review, from Rs 259 crore reported in the year-ago period
